meta.name: RPSGT v3 laboratory catalog
meta.copyrightBoundary: Catalog descriptions and task mappings are app-authored. Legacy lab content and protected source material are not copied into this catalog.

labs.title: Hookup and Electrode Placement
labs.description: Landmarks, measurements, placement, impedance, patient preparation, and correction of poor contact.

labs.title: EKG Recognition and Response
labs.description: Rhythm recognition, interval timing, sleep-study documentation, urgent findings, and escalation boundaries.

labs.title: Sleep Staging and Event Scoring
labs.description: Epoch review, stage criteria, arousals, respiratory events, limb movements, and scoring artifacts.

labs.title: Respiratory Signals and Event Recognition
labs.description: Airflow, effort, oximetry, CO2, snore, event classification, and signal-quality decisions.

labs.title: PAP and Titration
labs.description: Interfaces, pressure concepts, event response, leak, comfort, acclimation, and documentation.

labs.title: Instrumentation, Filters, and Signal Pathways
labs.description: Montages, sensitivities, sampling, filters, amplifiers, polarity, calibration, and troubleshooting.

labs.title: Pediatric and Infant Sleep
labs.description: Age-specific setup, staging context, respiratory scoring, CO2 monitoring, caregiver support, and safety.

labs.title: MSLT and MWT Protocols
labs.description: Preparation, timing, nap and trial structure, documentation, validity risks, and protocol boundaries.

labs.title: Integrated Troubleshooting
labs.description: Artifact recognition, equipment failure, patient events, corrective action, documentation, and escalation.

labs.title: Math Coach
labs.description: Indices, sleep calculations, timing, units, formula practice, lesson state, notes, and flagged review.
